Before/after source snapshots in result.json bind HEAD `1c761ee8a061a7f8e10c26f0e3aa1a436466d807` plus dedicated uncommitted files; sourceStable is true. The finalized commit is recorded in the external delivery manifest. The earlier initial response capture `crossdomain-pg-d46c4c0d7be3a7dd` remains historical external evidence; it lacks the new required metricMetadata and is not the finalized DTO fixture.

These are synthetic ERP facts, not production or public registered API receipts. Owning pair is7:3. Independent windows, signed metrics, no-record nulls, raw identity and unknown completeness remain native. The missing-order response refuses online/source-line fallback; the typed-zero response preserves an actual zero numerator with a positive trusted-order denominator, while historical cost/profit proof remains unverified. No fixture business formula was invented by the TS tests. Mutation tests clone these actual envelopes and corrupt enum types, COUNT/cents/quantity integrality, states, denominator meanings, scope/vector bindings and cost claims. They never delete mandatory metadata to make a success case fit.
